independent_review.findings: The first review requested a focused checksum-cleanup delete failure case. The follow-up test now covers it at service and HTTP boundaries. The final review confirmed generic failure envelopes/logs, no failed-upload metadata or audit, successful owner publication/audit, and alignment with the attachment OpenAPI status family.

limitations: File storage and repository in the HTTP test are in-memory fakes; this does not prove real S3/MinIO behavior, durable cleanup, PostgreSQL/RLS, or transactionality.
A cleanup delete outage can leave an unreferenced stored object; metadata and audit remain unpublished, but orphan inventory/retention reconciliation is outside this slice.
No live ClamAV, production storage, database, external service, Docker, listener, port, remote CI, target, or UAT was used.
M-27 remains partial pending real provider, persistence, and target-backed acceptance.
